purpose: Forecast the next recorded hourly zero-quantity state and evaluate rider station choice in archived data.
selection: Highest validation F1; ties prefer higher threshold. B1 and M1 use the same search budget. No test-based selection.
limitations: Cohort establishes observed quantity variation, not certified operating status.
The source column is 거치대수량 on a portal described as hourly available quantity; exact within-hour sampling semantics remain unverified.
Missing records are unknown, never zero.
Evaluation is next-record, rolling one-hour retrospective replay, not proof of 5-10 minute accuracy or actual rentals.
B1S is a separately evaluated snapshot-only baseline for live sample preview, not a replacement for B1 in the primary comparison.
